desc: Compressore Immagini Locale nel Browser. Ottimizzare e ridurre il peso di immagini JPG e PNG. PrivacyFold executes this tool 100% inside your local browser memory using WebAssembly, WebCrypto, and Canvas APIs. Zero server uploads.

seo.metaTitle: Compressore Immagini Locale nel Browser (100% Private) | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Ottimizzare e ridurre il peso di immagini JPG e PNG. Client-side browser processing with zero uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: PrivacyFold's Compressore Immagini Locale nel Browser operates directly inside the browser RAM to ottimizzare e ridurre il peso di immagini jpg e png with zero bytes sent to external cloud servers.
steps: Open or drop your file into the tool desk.
Process the data in browser memory.
Download your sanitized, private file immediately.

faqs.question: Are my files uploaded to any server?
faqs.answer: No. Everything is executed entirely inside your device's browser memory. Zero bytes leave your device.

faqs.question: How can I verify this privacy guarantee?
faqs.answer: Open your browser Developer Tools (F12), switch to the Network tab, and observe that exactly 0 network requests are made during processing.

whatToExpect.results: High-fidelity processed output with zero data loss.
whatToExpect.limits: Processes typical files up to 100 MB directly in RAM.
whatToExpect.benchmarks: Executed in sub-second speeds via WebAssembly and Canvas APIs.

privacyProof.howItWorks: Processed entirely inside the local browser sandbox using client-side JavaScript, WebAssembly, and WebCrypto.
verificationSteps: Open browser Developer Tools (F12) -> Network tab.
Execute the tool and verify 0 outbound network requests occur.
